complexity_ledger.narrative: EP-01 introduces the minimum Python batch lifecycle needed for project-owned semantic effects. Static preflight resolves case.input.action through actions.yml effect_ports, manifest role: effect Protocols, and exact case_adapters.toml provider tables before adapter instantiation. Runtime enters providers in declaration order, exposes a fresh immutable port-name map to setup/run/assert/teardown, and exits in reverse order on every failure path. Binding work directories exist before provider construction, and the case's before/input/output/after oracle fields are deep-snapshotted and mutation checked throughout the lifecycle. The pre-existing passive effects schema is separate and unchanged. Legacy empty semantic schemas bypass action lookup; provider-bearing non-batch execution fails before work/program generation. Validation and intentional V0 boundaries are recorded in results/validation-summary.md and results/zero-model-delta.md.

summary: Added typed project-owned effect-provider lookup and failure-safe Python batch lifecycle with zero host TLA+ model delta.

assertions: A case action deterministically resolves exactly its declared semantic effect ports and provider bindings; configuration errors fail before application code runs.
Generated typed Protocols remain the structural contract; the provider binding is checked against the selected port and is available by stable port name in AdapterCaseContext.effects.
Provider enter/setup/run/assert/teardown/exit ordering and reverse-order, failure-safe cleanup are covered, including teardown while providers remain active.
Explicit dependency injection and self-installed monkeypatch bindings are both possible without framework-specific application entrypoints beyond the existing case adapter.
Legacy batches with no semantic effect ports behave exactly as before; provider-bearing legacy non-batch/export paths are rejected rather than silently ignored.
Passive effect observation is unchanged and no generic per-call response-plan schema is introduced.
Zero host TLA+ model delta unless a new observable CLI transition is actually added; current == desired and TLC/spec-unit evidence records the decision.

ticket.objective: Add the smallest fail-closed runtime that maps a generated case's action to typed semantic effect ports and binds project-owned providers around that case. Reuse manifest `ports` as generated Protocol contracts, mark semantic effect ports explicitly, declare action requirements in actions.yml (`effect_ports`), and map each required port in case_adapters.toml (`[effect_providers.<Port>] provider = "module:object"`). Keep the inherited passive `effects:` observation schema separate: it detects escaped writes/process/network activity and is not a provider-response API. Introduce a provider context/binding contract and expose bound values through AdapterCaseContext.effects. Enter providers in declaration order before adapter setup; run setup/run/assert/teardown while bindings are live; exit providers in reverse order even on failure. Unknown ports, missing providers, duplicate bindings, invalid types, and provider-bearing unsupported execution modes fail before application execution. No-effect legacy batches remain compatible. V0 supports Python batch execution only.
